mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id FROM cart c INNER JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id WHERE ci.added_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = c.user_id AND o.ordered_at > ci.added_at )
SELECT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY user_id
SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(ordered_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

SELECT DISTINCT w.user_id FROM wishlist w WHERE w.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o INNER JOIN orders_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at > w.created_at AND w.product_id = oi.product_id AND o.user_id = w.user_id )
SELECT user_id FROM user_coupons WHERE used = false AND expires_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND expires_at <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days' GROUP BY user_id
SELECT user_id FROM reviews WHERE rating < 2 UNION SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED')
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_login_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND role = 'ROLE_USER'

SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN ordered_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END ) -- 창A (최근 30일) < SUM( CASE WHEN ordered_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ordered_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END ) * 0.5 -- 창B (직전 30일) × 0.5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO churn_score ( user_id, score, risk_level, risk_type, source ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{score}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskType}, #{source} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
